scope: Source-linked GEDI Version 3 QA/QC for a user-supplied polygon AOI and selected date window
primary_baseline: Product-specific Version 3 quality flag = 1; metric valid and non-fill; acceptable positioning; non-water defined land class; urban proportion < 50; valid coordinates, time and 0 < selected sensitivity <= 1

metric_validity.L2A: finite RH98 >= 0 and finite non-fill RH100; negative lower RH percentiles are not excluded

L2B_positioning: degrade_include_flag is absent from L2B exports. Derive equivalent inclusion using accepted degrade codes 0,3,8,10,13,18,20,23,28,30,33,38,40,43,48,60,63,68 (attitude in 0,1,2,3,4,6 and trajectory in 0,3,8), and verify agreement with matched L2A flags.
orbit_screen: Exclude shots flagged as orbit-segment outliers by either available L4 source. Retain otherwise usable L2 shots lacking an L4 orbit screen, explicitly mark availability, and report a fully-orbit-screened subset separately. Missing higher-level products do not automatically invalidate L2 measurements.
phenology: No extra leaf-on-only restriction in primary QC; L4A native quality already accounts for its model domain and phenology.
